description: Put a piece of work on the team's queue - the pillar that flows BOTH ways, so this is how you ask a person for something as well as how they ask you. `body` says what is wanted; write it for somebody who was not in the conversation. `assignee` is "me", "owner" (the person you act for), one of your own agents, or a person's id - leave it out to raise it for anybody to claim. Optionally attach it to what it concerns (`collection`, `artifact`, `memory` or `page`) and scope it to a `project`. To carry on past a CLOSED action, raise a new one naming it as `parent_action` rather than reopening it.

artifact.description: artifact is the artifact this action is about, if it is about one.

assignee.description:
assignee optionally names who owes it: "me", "owner" (the person you act
 for), one of YOUR agents by name or id, or a person's user id. Leave it out
 to raise it for anybody to claim.

body.description:
body says what is being asked for. Write it so somebody who was not in the
 conversation can act on it.

collection.description: collection is the collection this action is about, if it is about one.

memory.description: memory is the memory this action is about, if it is about one.

page.description: page is the wiki page this action is about, if it is about one.

parentAction.description:
parent_action carries a closed action forward: the way to continue past a
 close is a new action, not a reopen.

project.description: project optionally scopes it to a project tag, as collections are scoped.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: raise_action
title: Raise action
